style_dna: 近乎全白的高调画面：背景与主体同处极浅明度区间，仅靠一层极淡的灰阶落影把主体从底色中分离；整体低饱和到近乎无彩，唯一有彩的是一小块低饱和薄荷绿点缀；单一主体居中，四周留白宽度大致均等、合计约占画面八成；方形轮廓配超大半径圆角，圆角半径约为边长的四分之一，饱满但硬朗；表面为细腻哑光材质，边缘只有微弱的高光过渡，无镜面反射、无硬边阴影；大面积柔光箱顶部漫射光，光比极低；排版极克制，仅在画面底部保留一行字距极宽的极小号文字；整体安静、通透、克制的高级感
style_dna_en: Near-white high-key field: ground and subject sit in the same very light value range, separated only by a faint grey contact shadow; almost achromatic overall, with a single small patch of muted mint as the only chromatic accent; one centred subject with roughly equal margins on all sides, negative space totalling about 80 percent of the frame; squared silhouette with an oversized corner radius roughly a quarter of the edge length, full-bodied yet crisp; fine matte surfaces with only a soft highlight roll-off at the edges, no specular reflection and no hard-edged shadow; broad soft-box overhead diffusion at a very low lighting ratio; extremely restrained typography, just one line of widely tracked minute type along the bottom; quiet, airy, understated premium feel
notes: medium 判为 3d_render 但不排除是打光极干净的实拍：表面过渡与落影都过于完美，倾向渲染。这张图专门用来压非平面分支——光影描述会被正常编译出来。
